work_packet_header.workstream: authenticated classical and quantum control branch
work_packet_header.capability_or_component: classical unknown vector, two-patch Lobatto grids, residual row order and cross-grid norms
work_packet_header.downstream_gate_unlocked: state/grid portion of additive S4 proof definition

grid_meaning.N_definition: polynomial degree on each of two patches; each field has N+1 Lobatto nodal balls per patch

domain_partition_binding.use: post-solve interval residual, sign, curvature, completeness and remainder cover; not additional solve degrees of freedom

state_packing.coefficient_codec: apply the frozen DCT-I independently to each field/patch nodal array; omega remains scalar

dct_i.arithmetic: 512-bit directed outward; every cosine ball width <=2^-400
dct_i.fixture_identity: inverse(forward(f)) encloses every input nodal ball

core_rows.interior_j1_through_N_minus_1: the four frozen first-order R2 equations after dy/dr=(1-y)^2

infinity_rows.rule: the four frozen first-order R2 equations after dr/dq=-q^-2; q=0 is excluded from collocation and handled by the infinity recurrence proof

square_residual_map.b_infinity_rule: not a finite-wall boundary row; b(q=0)=1 must follow from the certified finite-mass infinity recurrence and strict positive branch
square_residual_map.p_infinity_rule: not an independent boundary row; p(q=0)=0 must follow from the certified exponential scalar-tail recurrence

frozen_cross_grid_norms.comparison: compare the two patch interpolants after DCT-I; zero-pad the lower-degree coefficient vector to the higher degree
frozen_cross_grid_norms.coefficient_prime_weight: endpoint coefficients k=0 and k=N carry reconstruction factor 1/2; all interior coefficients carry factor 1

norms_in_frozen_order.definition: max over eight field components of sum_k reconstruction_factor(k)*((17/16)^k)*abs(delta_a_k), together with abs(delta_omega)
max over eight field components of sum_k reconstruction_factor(k)*abs(delta_a_k), together with abs(delta_omega); valid because abs(T_k(x))<=1

frozen_cross_grid_norms.scaled_field_defect: maximum of the two frozen norms
frozen_cross_grid_norms.strict_contraction: for each norm, defect(N_next,N_after_next)<defect(N_prev,N_next) and ratio<=1/4 in the R2 grid order
frozen_cross_grid_norms.interval_rule: every absolute value, sum, maximum and ratio is outward-enclosed; a ratio interval with upper endpoint >1/4 fails
